title: A highly autonomous run, measured
lead: One session in which an assistant built a French explainer for class 5 from the guidance of this repository. A simulated creator answered its questions and later asked for a review, changes and measurements. This page counts how much the creator had to say, where the assistant got its information, and what the reviews and checks of the run found.
retrievalNote: The assistant fetched nothing from the open web in this run: it could not open lernapps.net, and the creator's session passed on the documents it needed.
findings: Learner check of the pattern page (before the creator saw it): the sub-agent used page 1 as a child of class 5 and found about a dozen places where a learner gets stuck: unexplained words (Artikel, Voilà, Vokal), a figure whose markers hid the objects, missing error messages. All were fixed before the page was shown.

Review of the committed app (review/prompt.md with the rubric, no listing pull request): {{verdict}} The findings the checks had not decided: a scope that named a date the page did not use, wrong "last page" references, an article rule that later pages broke, numbers 21 to 69 missing under the title "0 à 100", a licence question, and 4888 files of node_modules/ that had been committed. It did not notice that the two story children were nowhere in the drawings.

Walkthrough of the whole app as a child of class 5, from the start page to the last page: it found where pages did not fit together. A calendar showed Saturday while the text said Monday, three pages named the wrong page before them, a picture showed a book where the text said a pencil case, words were asked before they were taught (salut, le français, 0, 21 to 69), and the story jumped between places. Most were fixed in one commit.
findingsNote: lernapps check passed on the final state of each step and flagged none of these. The review and the learner checks found what the program could not decide: whether the pages fit together for a child.
limits: In this run the assistant was not allowed to open addresses of lernapps.net or to install skills. That is why the creator's session passed on the files. In a normal run they come from the package and from the app's folders.
The session waited overnight between the first work and the reviews.
